reviewContext.userProblem: Finish document pages and snippets: multi-page PDF and Markdown document export (app and CLI), CLI authoring of text.code, text.markdown and page frames, and the final registration, docs and examples wiring. dps-01..13 and dps-16 are accepted and committed at e8fd3c4.
requiredOutcomes: Multi-page PDF (one page per page frame, else per nodetto page) and Markdown export (snippets verbatim or fenced, other content as <stem>.assets/*.svg) from the desktop/web export menu and from nodetto-cli export --document --format pdf|markdown, with tests.
CommandIo.ensureDir is recursive and idempotent in Bun (local-io.ts) and native (engine.rs), with tests; the Markdown export calls it before writing <stem>.assets/.
nodetto-cli creates and edits text.code (canonical languages), text.markdown and page frames; the end-to-end text.code add assertion passes in apps/cli/src/document-wiring.test.ts.
Registration in registry, palette, CLI shape catalogue and help; docs/cli.md, docs/editing.md, docs/import-export.md and README.md; examples (vertical paper, horizontal deck).
The store replaces element objects on update (markdown layout WeakMap cache), pinned by test.
mise run verify and mise run test-cli pass on the final tree.
nonGoals: Re-implementing or redesigning dps-01..13 and dps-16.
A new Command kind, a schema or version bump, a new dependency, or new CSS tokens.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths, their progress file and their evidence directory. No git state changes, no any, no emojis.

Rust commands run with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and a per-plan CARGO_TARGET_DIR (target/dps-14, target/dps-15, target/dps-17), except mise run verify and mise run test-cli, which must use the default target dir because test-cli executes $PWD/target/release/nodetto-cli.
test-cli gets up to 3 attempts only on deadline timeouts. Deadlines are never relaxed and binary-less parity runs are forbidden.
JSONL round trips stay byte-identical. No push; local commits only, with no tool attribution.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CommandIo.ensureDir?(path): Promise<void> is optional; Bun uses mkdir recursive, native uses create_dir_all through a host arm exposed like writeBytes.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Owner decision IR-DPS14-HOST-MKDIR; optional matches writeBytes? and keeps unrelated CommandIo fakes unchanged (design 7.4).

residualRisks: Whole-repo bun run typecheck in a parallel wave can see a sibling mid-edit; rerun after joining before declaring failure.
Both wave-1 plans list the target artifact root; Rust builds are separated by CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
intentionalTradeoffs: dps-17 is broad (43 write paths) but runs serially in wave 2 so shared registration, barrels and docs are reconciled once.
Wave-1 plans share only the target artifact root; Rust builds are isolated with per-plan CARGO_TARGET_DIR instead of splitting ownership further.
The end-to-end text.code add assertion moves to dps-17 document-wiring.test.ts so dps-15 verification is registry-independent (IR-DPS15-DAG-VERIFY).
packages/core/src/markdown-snippet/layout.ts is changed only if the store-identity test shows elements are not replaced on update.
supportedEdgeCases: Documents without page frames export one PDF page per nodetto page.
Members shared by overlapping page frames are de-duplicated; snippets are emitted once.
<stem>.assets/ is created recursively and idempotently via CommandIo.ensureDir (Bun and native).
--document is accepted with pdf and markdown in explicit and shorthand forms through one code path; native parity is checked in dps-17.
Unknown text.code languages are rejected; aliases normalise to canonical ids; language defaults to plain and code to an empty string.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Changes to accepted dps-01..13 and dps-16 behaviour beyond wiring.
New Command kinds, schema or version bumps, new dependencies or light-only CSS fallbacks.
Cloud or server-side export and sync behaviour.
